<h1>Hi! I am Fernanda</h1>
<p>I am a data analyst with a background in biomedical sciences. I am from Brazil and I am also an R-Lady.</p>
<p>Since 2017, I create content about statistics and data analysis for research workers on my YouTube channel. My main interests are hypothesis testing, data visualization and R Programming.</p>
